slug: 2025-12-18 Cabo Verde advances digitalisation of National Health System (SNS)

facts.fact: Inforpress reports that on 18 December 2025 the Minister of Health, Jorge Figueiredo, announced a unique patient identification code and digital medical records centralising clinical data across facilities, so that professionals will see a patient's history whichever hospital or health centre is attended; stated as coming, with no count of facilities.
